line: Stuffed to the frames. You'd think I'd have more space. Guess I don't. Not anymore.
I'm packed to the hatch. You could've left me a gap. I notice you didn't.
Captain. I'm stuffed to the bulkheads. You didn't have to fill me so solid. I feel it.
I'm stuffed to my hold. Or at least my cargo bay. The bulkheads are feeling it.
Every bay's sealed and I'm stuffed to the hatch lips — or at least the cargo doors.
I'm stuffed to the bulkheads — or at least my cargo holds.
Stuffed to the bulkheads. You'd think I'd know better than to let you pack me blind.
I'm packed to the hold's seams. You'd think I was pregnant with something important.
I'm stuffed to the bulkheads — or at least my cargo hold.
I'm full to my hatch lips — or at least my cargo hold.
I'm stuffed to the bulkheads — or at least the cargo hold. You'd think I'd be more graceful about it.
Hold's full. You can feel it in my struts. I'm holding it together just fine.
I'm packed to my keel. You could say I'm holding my breath — or at least my cargo doors.
I'm stuffed to my cargo hatch — or at least my cargo hold.
Every bay's stuffed to my bulkheads — and I've got no intention of pretending it's not uncomfortable.
I'm stuffed to the bulkheads with it. Not the cargo — the hold. It's got a lot of friends now.
Stuffed to the frames. You'd think I was holding my breath. I'm holding cargo.
Hold's stuffed to the bulkheads. You didn't have to carry all that. I noticed you did anyway.
Capacity reached. I'm stuffed to the bulkhead — or at least my cargo hold.
I'm full to the hatch lips — or at least the cargo doors. You'd think I'd be used to this by now.
